props.title: Measured 2020–2026
props.author: Paul Love
props.content:
In 2020, we started Measured as a digital product consultancy, providing UI design systems consulting and contractor-staffed product engineering services.

Over six years, we worked with high-growth startups like [Hubble](https://measured.co/work/hubble) (since acquired by [Yardi](https://www.yardi.com/)), and large corporates including [Hilton](https://measured.co/work/hilton), [BT](https://measured.co/work/bt), and [dunnhumby](https://measured.co/work/dunnhumby), building the design foundations and the teams to deliver them.

Following the conclusion of our final client engagement, we've made the decision to close Measured in 2026.

It's been a good run, and we'd like to say thanks to all of those who were a part of it.

— [Paul](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paullove/) and [Scott](https://www.linkedin.com/in/scottboyle/)
